id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

port.description: The port on which the proxy will listen messages from the process being debugged

implLanguageExecutor.description: Used to inform client to connect the correct debug adapter to this proxy

socketServer.description: The instance of Java.net.ServerSocket which the action process will connect to.

socketClient.description: The instance of Java.net.Socket which is created when an action is connected to the socketServer.

title:
DAP Proxy stands for Debug Adapter Protocol Proxy.
It is a proxy that acts as a Debugger Adapter Client for the process running on the server
the implementation should be programming language agnostic
name: Debugger.DapProxy
